reviews.text: I bought my own Fressnapf (expensive) products that made my dog ​​vomit, but I couldn't exchange them for a block, nor did I get my money back. Although "Fressnapf provides a permanent "Satisfaction Guarantee" (Acceptance Guarantee) on its own brand products" in reality this is a lie. A small company with terrible quality of its own products. The business is terrible.
I can always buy for my cat!
Good place, great selection 🐕 …

It's not my first time at Fressnapf on Bajza Street/I always try to give it another chance, but this is the last time!!! The other day I bought a relatively large package of litter/that's not why I went. I should have turned around when I entered/they didn't greet me. I went to the cashier/I don't know if anyone was trained or not/I even apologized for disturbing you. They didn't answer my question politely, with a slap in the face. I would like to point out that I was with a cane because I had a minor accident. This will be an important moment at the end! My husband was waiting outside because parking was not possible. I also bought an item that wasn't included in the price/litter. I'm limping there at the moment with a heavy litter for me and I bought something else. The two of them were sitting at the cashier, a young girl with full-length blonde hair, 50 plus! She wouldn't have moved to help; Meanwhile, a third young girl appeared and went to them. I paid, took the small item out in my hand, leaving the litter/because it was difficult for me/directly! Then the blonde employee came after me, saying that I had left the litter there. I indicated that I knew and my husband came in to get it to take it out. It didn't even occur to her to bring it after me!!! I work in the commercial sector. We work with an incredibly high turnover, we often struggle with a lack of people, the store is full, but we don't behave like this towards anyone, especially a person who clearly needs help/not anyway!!!! Especially not with folded arms!!! There were two people in the room besides me. This attitude is bloodthirsty! It's not the first time, I won't set foot in this facility again!!! Unfortunately, no substantive change is happening, because according to them this has been going on with impunity for years, without any retaliation!!!
The attitude of the employees was unfriendly and it's a shame the store is large and has a wide selection.
The selection is very good and there are many varieties and there are often sales and the store is very spacious and I am ready to help!!!! 😀 …
Great prices, wide selection
The best pet store in Budapest. Wide selection of products.
It's great that there's a store like this here, it's a shame there's no service... you stand at the empty cash register for 10 minutes and no one is there...
Very great store, I get everything my dogs need. Polite staff, clear sales area, clean and tidy. I can recommend it to everyone who has dogs or cats 💖💖 …

Amazingly rude service. I personally do not recommend it to anyone. I ordered online 10 days ago and they have not delivered anything since then, so today I asked for my money back, which fortunately they refunded. The phone operator did not even apologize, he was just as rude as his colleagues in the store - maybe rudeness is a company expectation. I think anything is better than this store. Let's just say they teach the dog to cook, out of necessity.
I found everything I wanted, lovely shop.

I actually did not find any problem with this place. Some things seem more overpriced then in other petstores but they got pretty good quality things and a wide selection of literally anythin u could think of for any pet.
Friendly, helpful sales team. :)
It’s a big place where you can find anything you’re looking for, and the prices are reasonable. The staff are friendly and will help you find what you need. They also speak good English.
Their professional expertise is lacking. Unfortunately.

The behavior of the blonde saleswoman, around 50, is below criticism. We waited for long minutes at the checkout, she didn't even come when we rang the bell, even though she was standing there 2 m away, but she was busy with a "golden bug puppy", not with the customers. She didn't say hello, she pointed at the products for me to bring them closer to her (is the tape not working or what?), then with long sighs she deigned to pull them down. Never again in this business, it was terribly unpleasant.
Small but well-equipped shop.
There's everything here that would appeal to the eyes and mouths of your favorites. She's a bit of a grumpy cashier, but she's clearly not here to make friends.
It's good to have a store like this in the city center.
Quality at a price that is not on sale is priceless. The cashier's constant hustling is annoying.

They barely greeted me when I entered. No one came to ask if they could help me. Okay. I should note that I went 1.5 hours before closing, I didn't even come in 5 minutes before closing. Instead of greeting me loudly at the cash register, the blonde lady around 50-60 moaned and continued to rummage in the trash can. When she finally wanted to climb out of it, after another moan, she pulled the items down and stared at me. I think I'll guess the amount from the eye contact... After I said I would pay with kp (she still didn't say the amount), she placed the change (usually when paying with a lot of money, they count it in front of the customer's eyes, so that they give it back correctly) on the purchased item instead of my outstretched hand. Without even waiting for me to put the change down, she already pulled the next customer's products down on mine. Let me tell you that I work in retail and I know that there are bad days, especially when you have to serve people for 6+ hours, but this was inhumane behavior. I still don't know if the lady even speaks Hungarian because not a word left her mouth, only Neanderthal vocalizations.
